What stayed the same?

- undo restores `(10,0)`
- tangency becomes true again
- delete/undo correctly updates workspace and context
- both circles move together vertically
- centers' y-values change
- radii remain unchanged
- distance between centers remains 10
- tangency remains true
- shape/size remain unchanged
